title: 7 Major GTA 6 Questions the Previews Haven't Answered So Far
text: 7 Major GTA 6 Questions the Previews Haven't Answered Menu Zelda GTA 6 Guides Pokémon Like Follow Followed 2 2 More Action Add Us Newsletter Sign in Sign in Now Close What To Play What to Watch Gaming Submenu News Reviews Previews Features Entertainment Submenu News Reviews Features Pick a genre Submenu Anime Horror Sci-Fi Fantasy Guides Submenu Subnautica 2 Forza Horizon 6 Pokémon Go All Guides Videos Sign in Newsletter Array Copyright © 2026 www.polygon.com --> Close Like Follow Followed Thread 2 Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Link copied to clipboard By Jen Glennon Updated Sep 15, 2026, 5:35 PM EDT Analysis Rockstar's Netflix preview has given us much to ponder 7 major questions we still have about GTA 6 Image: Grant Walkup / Polygon Sign in to your Polygon.com account Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 2 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Netflix's extended look at Grand Theft Auto 6 has come and gone, and fans the world over are sifting through all the details about the most anticipated game of 2026. Given Rockstar's unusual move of debuting the footage on Netflix, it wasn't clear what to expect from the show, but it was a pretty straightforward gameplay deep-dive, without any commentary from developers. While there are more details to uncover in other previews in the weeks heading up to the Nov. 19 launch, there are several major questions about GTA 6 that we still have no concrete answers for. Here are several of the biggest ones. 1 What kind of customization can we expect with GTA 6? Image: Rockstar Games We've seen glimpses of Jason's house and Lucia's apartment in official footage of GTA 6 , and we learned from previews that players won't be able to purchase additional houses . (According to Rockstar, it wouldn't make sense for a couple on the run to be constantly expanding their real estate portfolio, which makes sense.) Still, there is a lot that could happen in terms of customization of both these spaces, especially Jason's house, which appears to be in various stages of construction during the first two trailers. We also know that you'll be able to alter Jason and Lucia's appearance through working out, sleeping, and diet choices. It's not clear if you'll be able to take this to extremes, or whether the changes will be relatively subtle, like with Arthur Morgan in Red Dead Redemption 2. 2 How much storage space will we need for GTA 6? Image: Rockstar Games With Rockstar going digital-only for the release of GTA 6, it's fair to assume that PlayStation and Xbox owners will need to clear a fair bit of storage space on their consoles' hard drives ahead of the Nov. 19 launch. Several PS5 games clock in at more than 100GB of space, including Gran Turismo 7 at 197 GB, Mortal Kombat 1 at 177 GB, and Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth at 150 GB. Given the flashy visuals and expansive map we're expecting to see in GTA 6, we wouldn't be surprised to see the game approach — or even clear — the 200 GB mark. 3 When is the PC version of GTA 6 coming out? Screenshot: Polygon via Rockstar Games At present, Rockstar Games has only announced that GTA 6 will launch for PS5 and Xbox Series X. A PC launch seems inevitable, but the developer's past track record for ports suggests PC gamers are in for a significant wait. Red Dead 2 came to PC a little more than a year after it launched on PS4 and Xbox One. Meanwhile, GTA 5 came to PC about 19 months after the console release. While it could be as soon as late 2027, we'd expect it's more likely we'll see GTA 6 on PC in early 2028. 4 What's happening with Grand Theft Auto Online? Image: Rockstar Games Back in June, when Rockstar revealed pricing and preorder details for the upcoming game, the company emphasized that the game is a " single-player experience ." Still, that hasn't stopped people from speculating about whether Rockstar's working on an all-new online game to launch sometime after GTA 6 , or whether the existing GTA Online will expand to incorporate elements of the latest game, including locations and events inspired by the game. We know from financial leaks earlier this year that GTAO continues to be a massive money-maker for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two Interactive, so we expect they'll want to keep that cash-machine humming. We've unpacked what the future of GTAO could look like here: Related Will we get a new GTA Online with GTA 6? It's looking increasingly less likely What will Rockstar do with its always-on sandbox come November? Posts 9 5 Who is in the GTA 6 cast? Image: Rockstar Games Even though we've seen nearly half an hour of official footage of Jason and Lucia's adventures in vehicle theft and sharpshooting, we still don't know the names of the actors playing either of them. Rockstar hasn't released any information about the game's main or supporting cast. But Stephen Root, a freshly anointed Emmy winner for Widow's Bay , known for his previous roles in King of the Hill and Office Space , recently confirmed to the Associated Press that he'll be playing Brian Heder in GTA 6 , a gruff mentor figure who doles out assignments to Jason and Lucia. In past GTA installments, Rockstar looked to well-known movie and TV actors to fill out the cast. 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City included a number of big names, including Ray Liotta, Tom Sizemore, Dennis Hopper, Danny Trejo, Debbie Harry, and Jenna Jameson. In 2004, Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas starred Ice-T, Samuel L. Jackson, James Woods, Charlie Murphy, and David Cross, among many others. A longstanding (but unconfirmed) rumor claims that Liotta might have reprised his role as the Hawaiian shirt-loving protagonist Tommy Vercetti in San Andreas , but he asked for more money than Rockstar was willing to pay. Given that the cast hasn't leaked yet, it's safe to assume that GTA 6 will keep with the tradition Rockstar established with GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2: an ensemble of less widely known, yet very accomplished voice actors. (Trust me, if Tom Holland was playing Jason, we would have known five years ago.) Make a break for our full GTA 6 coverage ❯ ❯ ❯ ❯ 6 Can Jason and Lucia have sex? Image: Rockstar/Netflix via Polygon While we saw clear evidence that Jason and Lucia were shacking up in the Netflix reveal — early on, Jason helps himself to a soda in an apartment with flamingo-print wallpaper and pink fairy lights that I suspect is Lucia's house, not his — we did not find out whether you'll get to go all "Hot Coffee" with our leading couple. While your in-game romance will require maintenance and good behavior on both sides, Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said you can keep Jason and Lucia's relationship strictly platonic. "I have to say it feels great — if you are into it as a concept. Don’t bother with it if you aren’t. Up to you," Nelson told IGN . "The narrative is structured in such a way that the circumstances they find themselves in require them to stay together for most of the story and work together. At the very least they will get through most things as partners in crime." While we still don't know if GTA 6 will let you engage in conjugal bliss, we know from previous leaks that the game will contain strip clubs and a nudist colony, and all body types are represented in vivid detail. Yes, there is full frontal in GTA 6 , though we may not have seen it on Netflix. 7 Can you keep a gator as a pet in GTA 6? Image: Rockstar Games The frankly underwhelming cover art for GTA 6 prominently features a smiling, toothsome gator, who fans have affectionately dubbed " Auto ." Though the Netflix reveal featured a brief and enticing fan-boat sequence, there were appallingly few Gator Moments during the broadcast. We've seen gators in previous trailers, and we saw a cute pitbull in the latest footage. If I have to work out and maintain healthy sleep hygiene in this game, you must let me keep a dangerous, truck-sized reptile as a pet. People do this in Florida all the time! Get Strauss Zelnick on the phone immediately. Grand Theft Auto 6 will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X on Nov. 19.
